verdict: Organic reach is contracting sharply; paid channels are currently off.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Business Profile was the only active channel — paid advertising ran at zero spend and produced zero leads. Within that window, GBP engagement dropped 78% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days before, and search clicks fell 43% over the same stretch, confirming this is a real trend rather than a one-week anomaly. The root cause is shrinking visibility in Google Maps and search: your profile generated just 355 impressions over 25 days, which limits how many people can act even when they do find you. Paid campaigns are being brought back online to rebuild top-of-funnel volume, and GBP signals are being reviewed to address the visibility drop.
